mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.admin_hidden=TRUE OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR p.status = 4 THEN 'removed' WHEN p.status = 3 THEN 'rejected' WHEN p.status IN (0, 1) THEN 'pending' ELSE 'published' END
CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR c.status IN (3, 4) THEN 'removed' WHEN c.status = 2 THEN 'rejected' WHEN c.status = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'published' END

SELECT p.id, p.post_type,p.category_id, 'post' AS type, 'POST' AS authorization_namespace, COALESCE(p.title, '') AS title, LEFT(p.content, 160) AS content_preview, p.user_id AS author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, '已注销用户') AS author_name, AS status, CASE p.audit_status WHEN 1 THEN 'approved' WHEN 2 THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'pending' END AS audit_status, p.is_pinned AS pinned, p.is_featured AS featured, COALESCE(reports.report_count, 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(p.view_count, 0) AS view_count, CASE WHEN p.post_type IN('NORMAL','MENTOR_QA') THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_record lr WHERE lr.target_type=1 AND lr.target_id=p.id) ELSE COALESCE(p.like_count,0) END AS like_count, CASE WHEN p.post_type IN('NORMAL','MENTOR_QA') THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment n WHERE n.target_type=1 AND n.target_id=p.id AND n.status=1 AND n.deleted_at IS NULL AND (n.parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment root WHERE root.id=n.parent_id AND root.parent_id IS NULL AND root.target_id=n.target_id AND root.target_type=1 AND ((root.status=1 AND root.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (root.status IN(3,4) AND n.community_thread=TRUE))))) ELSE COALESCE(p.comment_count,0) END AS comment_count, COALESCE(p.share_count, 0) AS share_count, p.published_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, p.status AS raw_status FROM post p LEFT JOIN user_profile author ON author.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count FROM report WHERE target_type = 1 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) reports ON reports.target_id = p.id
UNION ALL
SELECT c.id, NULL AS post_type,NULL AS category_id, 'comment' AS type, CASE c.target_type WHEN 1 THEN 'POST' WHEN 2 THEN 'ACTIVITY' WHEN 3 THEN 'PUBLIC_EVENT' ELSE 'UNSUPPORTED' END AS authorization_namespace, '' AS title, LEFT(c.content, 160) AS content_preview, c.user_id AS author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, '已注销用户') AS author_name, AS status, CASE c.audit_status WHEN 1 THEN 'approved' WHEN 2 THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'pending' END AS audit_status, NULL AS pinned, NULL AS featured, COALESCE(reports.report_count, 0) AS report_count, NULL AS view_count, COALESCE(c.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(c.reply_count, 0) AS comment_count, NULL AS share_count, c.created_at AS published_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, c.status AS raw_status FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user_profile author ON author.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count FROM report WHERE target_type = 4 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) reports ON reports.target_id = c.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(content.status = 'published'), 0) AS published, COALESCE(SUM(content.status = 'pending'), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(content.report_count > 0), 0) AS reported, COALESCE(SUM(content.status = 'removed' AND content.deleted_at >= CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS removed_today FROM ( SELECT 'post' AS type, 'POST' AS authorization_namespace, AS status, p.deleted_at, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM report post_report WHERE post_report.target_type = 1 AND post_report.target_id = p.id AND post_report.status = 0 ) AS report_count FROM post p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_growth_record g WHERE g.post_id=p.id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'comment' AS type, CASE c.target_type WHEN 1 THEN 'POST' WHEN 2 THEN 'ACTIVITY' WHEN 3 THEN 'PUBLIC_EVENT' ELSE 'UNSUPPORTED' END AS authorization_namespace, AS status, c.deleted_at, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM report comment_report WHERE comment_report.target_type = 4 AND comment_report.target_id = c.id AND comment_report.status = 0 ) AS report_count FROM comment c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_growth_record g WHERE c.target_type=1 AND g.post_id=c.target_id) ) content

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post published_post WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_growth_record g WHERE g.post_id=published_post.id) AND published_post.user_id = author.id AND published_post.status = 2 AND published_post.deleted_at IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment published_comment WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_growth_record g WHERE published_comment.target_type=1 AND g.post_id=published_comment.target_id) AND published_comment.user_id = author.id AND published_comment.status = 1 AND published_comment.deleted_at IS NULL)

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post violation_post WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_growth_record g WHERE g.post_id=violation_post.id) AND violation_post.user_id = author.id AND violation_post.audit_status = 2) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment violation_comment WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_growth_record g WHERE violation_comment.target_type=1 AND g.post_id=violation_comment.target_id) AND violation_comment.user_id = author.id AND violation_comment.audit_status = 2)
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_type,p.category_id,p.id, 'post' AS type, COALESCE(p.title, '') AS title, LEFT(p.content, 160) AS content_preview, p.content, p.user_id AS author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, '已注销用户') AS author_name, AS status, CASE p.audit_status WHEN 1 THEN 'approved' WHEN 2 THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'pending' END AS audit_status, p.is_pinned AS pinned, p.is_featured AS featured, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.target_type = 1 AND r.target_id = p.id AND r.status = 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(p.view_count, 0) AS view_count, CASE WHEN p.post_type IN('NORMAL','MENTOR_QA') THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_record lr WHERE lr.target_type=1 AND lr.target_id=p.id) ELSE COALESCE(p.like_count,0) END AS like_count, CASE WHEN p.post_type IN('NORMAL','MENTOR_QA') THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment n WHERE n.target_type=1 AND n.target_id=p.id AND n.status=1 AND n.deleted_at IS NULL AND (n.parent_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM comment root WHERE root.id=n.parent_id AND root.parent_id IS NULL AND root.target_id=n.target_id AND root.target_type=1 AND ((root.status=1 AND root.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (root.status IN(3,4) AND n.community_thread=TRUE))))) ELSE COALESCE(p.comment_count,0) END AS comment_count, COALESCE(p.share_count, 0) AS share_count, p.published_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, p.status AS raw_status, p.reject_reason, author.status AS author_status, author.created_at AS author_created_at, AS author_published_count, AS author_violation_count FROM post p LEFT JOIN user_profile author ON author.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{contentId}

SELECT c.id, 'comment' AS type, '' AS title, LEFT(c.content, 160) AS content_preview, c.content, c.user_id AS author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, '已注销用户') AS author_name, AS status, CASE c.audit_status WHEN 1 THEN 'approved' WHEN 2 THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'pending' END AS audit_status, NULL AS pinned, NULL AS featured, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.target_type = 4 AND r.target_id = c.id AND r.status = 0) AS report_count, NULL AS view_count, COALESCE(c.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(c.reply_count, 0) AS comment_count, NULL AS share_count, c.created_at AS published_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, c.status AS raw_status, NULL AS reject_reason, c.image_url, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.parent_id, author.status AS author_status, author.created_at AS author_created_at, AS author_published_count, AS author_violation_count FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user_profile author ON author.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{contentId}
